period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported), compared against the prior period-end position. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January of the same year, as published in the bank's own 'Un-audited Balance Sheet' and 'Un-audited Profit and Loss Account' for the period ended 30 June 2024. SOLO/STANDALONE basis (header reads 'Mercantile Bank PLC.' / 'Mercantile Bank Limited' Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Account with no 'and its Subsidiaries'/'Consolidated' qualifier; the same source PDF also contains an earlier CONSOLIDATED Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss Account section headed 'Mercantile Bank PLC. and its Subsidiaries', which was correctly identified and NOT used, consistent with this bank's established SOLO reporting_basis). SOURCE PDF WAS A SCANNED IMAGE (0 lines extractable via pdftotext) -- recovered via OCR: rendered to PNG with pdftoppm at 250 DPI, then run through tesseract (--psm 6). Every balance-sheet and P&L subtotal was manually cross-checked against every internal arithmetic identity before being trusted -- balance-sheet identity (Total Assets = sum of 8 asset lines = Total Liabilities + Total Equity), Total Liabilities composition (Borrowings + Subordinated Bond + Perpetual Bond + Deposits + Other Liabilities), the full operating-income chain (Net Interest Income + Investment Income + Commission/Exchange/Brokerage + Other Operating Income = Total Operating Income), the expense/provision/tax/net-profit chain, the appropriation chain (Net Profit + Retained Surplus b/f = Appropriations + Retained Surplus c/f, cross-tied to the Balance Sheet's own Surplus-in-P&L line), Off-Balance-Sheet composition, and EPS (Net Profit / (Paid-up Capital / 10 par value)). This redundant-arithmetic approach caught and corrected specific OCR digit-substitution errors (documented per-period below) before any figure was accepted into this dataset; periods where a figure could not be confidently resolved this way were left as reported without forcing a correction. Four separate '1' <-> '4' leading-digit OCR substitution errors were found and corrected via redundant arithmetic, cross-checked against a second, differently-formatted table on the same source page (a 4-column cumulative+discrete-quarter breakdown) and against the FY2025-H1 filing's own Jan-24-to-Jun-24 comparative column, both of which independently confirm every correction below: (1) Non-convertible Subordinated Bond read as 4,200,000,000, corrected to 1,200,000,000 (Total Liabilities tied out only with the corrected value, exactly). (2) Paid-up capital read as 411,065,754,350 (an extra leading digit), corrected to 11,065,754,350 (the constant value in every other period in this dataset). (3) Interest/Profit Paid on deposits, borrowings etc. (interest expense) read as 40,160,080,183, corrected to 10,160,080,183 (Net interest income = Interest income - this figure ties out only with the corrected value, exactly). (4) Other operating income read as 4,430,399,806 on the primary table, corrected to 1,430,399,806 using the secondary 4-column table's own (correct) reading -- Total operating income ties out only with the corrected value. Total shareholders' Equity (27,068,430,060) could not be exactly rebuilt from its own component reserve lines (a ~30,000,000 residual, likely a further OCR error in one sub-line not resolved), but is independently confirmed correct via the balance-sheet identity Total Assets - Total Liabilities = 432,064,399,208 - 404,995,969,147 = 27,068,430,061 (matches to BDT 1). Retained surplus for the half-year (1,108,749,742) plus the Dec-23 Balance Sheet's Surplus-in-P&L (1,129,239,228) does not equal the Jun-24 Surplus-in-P&L (1,131,413,536); the ~1,106.6m gap matches almost exactly 10% of paid-up capital, consistent with a cash dividend paid out of FY2023 profit during H1 2024 (not an error).
